title: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles isn’t worried about ‘distractions’ heading into camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles isn’t worried about ‘distractions’ heading into camp
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers opened training camp with two contract situations hanging over the organization, but head coach Todd Bowles does not expect either to derail the team’s preparation.
